_: What a test run has to contain to count as one. Read by
Tools/validate-test-result.py, which Tools/test.sh runs after every run.
bundles: every test bundle the scheme is supposed to run, and the smallest
number of tests it may report. A floor, not an equality — adding tests never
touches this file. Lowering one means tests were deleted, and that should be
as visible in a diff as deleting them was. A bundle that runs and is not
listed here fails too: an undeclared target is a target that can vanish
diagnosticAllowlist: compiler and analyzer warnings this repository has
decided to live with, each fingerprinted as 'issueType: message', with a
reason and the issue tracking it. Use fingerprintPrefix only where the
message carries an absolute path and so cannot be named exactly. Short is
requiredAttachments / visualFailureAttachments: evidence the run has to
leave behind. The render baseline records what it rendered on every run,
and a visual failure has to leave images a person can look at. See #138.

diagnosticAllowlist.reason: llvm-profdata complains that a coverage profile was produced by a different binary than the one being merged. It is a property of a DerivedData directory that a previous run wrote into, not of the code: a clean CI runner never produces it, and a developer who edits a test between two local runs always does. Its message quotes an absolute path, so it cannot be fingerprinted exactly.
